newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil to pay US $867,000 in spill case.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil to pay US $867,000 in spill case.

text.p: Two Pennzoil Co units agreed to pay $867,000 in penalties for more than 100 small oil pipeline spills that allegedly polluted waters in West Virginia and western Pennsylvania, the U.S. Justice Department said Thursday.

It said an amended lawsuit and a settlement had been filed in federal court in West Virginia on Wednesday. The lawsuit alleged 106 unlawful oil spills between 1993 and 1996, many of which were caused by corrosion on Pennzoil's pipelines.

Justice Department officials said Pennzoil agreed to take various corrective steps, including the removal of 19 miles of pipeline from active service, more testing and visual inspection and the creation of a review committee for pipeline corrosion. The units involved in the settlement were Pennzoil Products Co. and Eureka Pipeline Co., both of which are based in Vienna, West Virginia.
